findings.title: Old positional CLI form still runs as blood pressure
findings.description: `main` rewrites two float-parseable bare arguments as a `bp` invocation, while `test_cli_requires_subcommand` drops the case that checked rejection of `186 104`. As a result, `python -m agents.health_sentinel 186 104` no longer prints usage and exits non-zero, and values such as `nan` or `inf` pass the shim and reach `VitalReading` construction.

citations.citation: Introduce bp and hr CLI subcommands

raw = sys.argv[1:] if argv is None else argv
    if len(raw) == 2 and all(_is_number(a) for a in raw):
        # Backward compatibility: `186 104` used to mean blood pressure.
        raw = ["bp", *raw]
Preserve existing test checks unless the change requires their modification

evidence.explanation: Compliance rule 4969703 requires the old `186 104` form to print usage and exit non-zero, but the rewrite at `agents/health_sentinel/__main__.py` lines 39–41 turns it into an accepted `bp` invocation. The `['186', '104']` case was removed from `test_cli_requires_subcommand` at `tests/test_cli.py` line 58 so that shim would pass, despite compliance rule 4969698 allowing an existing check to change only when the intended behavior requires it.
